goal: Improve txt2audio reliability, documentation accuracy, and test coverage while preserving existing chapter parsing and CosyVoice behavior.
guardrails: Do not broaden chapter-recognition regex before baseline tests are added.
Keep tmp-file atomic writes for wav, mp3, mp4, srt, and future export formats.
Do not upgrade the pinned CosyVoice-compatible torch stack without audio quality verification.
Treat CosyVoice frontend text normalization as the owner of ttsfrd/wetext fallback unless code changes explicitly move that responsibility.

tracks.title: Make media conversion failures affect CLI status and exit code
tracks.current_issue: MP3 and MP4 conversion failures are logged but can still leave the main CLI reporting success.
implementation_notes: MP3 and MP4 conversion helpers now raise RuntimeError on ffmpeg failure after cleaning tmp outputs.
cli_main_process() aggregates conversion failures and returns exit code 1 when any conversion fails.
JSON and human output include failed target paths and error messages.
acceptance: ffmpeg failure exits with code 1.
JSON mode reports a non-success status and failure details.
Successful conversion still uses tmp -> final atomic replacement.

tracks.title: Return structured errors for invalid --range values
tracks.current_issue: Invalid range input can raise an uncaught exception, and reverse ranges can become empty successful runs.
implementation_notes: parse_range_string() validates allowed forms: all, N, start~end, start-end.
Negative, non-numeric, reversed, and out-of-range values are rejected with clear messages.
cli_main_process() routes invalid range errors through _report_error().
acceptance: --json --range abc returns a JSON error and exit code 1.
--range 8~0 returns an error.
Existing all, 5, and 0~8 behavior remains unchanged.

tracks.title: Generate SRT only when requested by the active output workflow
tracks.current_issue: Pure audio runs can leave .srt subtitle files even though SRT is currently described as an intermediate video subtitle artifact.
implementation_notes: generate_audio_clip() now accepts generate_subtitles.
The CLI enables SRT generation only for --video with video.subtitles=true.
A future explicit keep/export subtitle CLI flag remains a backlog option.
acceptance: Default MP3/WAV runs do not create .srt files.
Video subtitle mode still burns subtitles and cleans SRT after successful MP4 creation.
Video failure preserves useful intermediate files for retry/debugging.

tracks.title: Add regression tests before changing chapter recognition
tracks.current_issue: Chapter parsing is behaviorally important and sensitive to regex changes, but construct_text_and_name() has no direct test coverage.
implementation_notes: Added baseline tests for current Chinese numeral volume/chapter parsing.
Added coverage for intro fallback and duplicate heading behavior.
Added coverage for display/output path separation.
More special-section fixtures can still be added before any parser expansion.
acceptance: Baseline tests pass without changing parser behavior.
Future parser enhancements can be reviewed against these tests.

tracks.title: Align README and CLAUDE.md with current implementation
tracks.current_issue: CLAUDE.md still mentions split_long_sentences(), broad polyphone coverage, and no formal tests, which no longer match the codebase.
implementation_notes: README and CLAUDE.md now describe CosyVoice frontend ttsfrd/wetext fallback accurately.
Docs now describe the current conservative polyphone coverage instead of broad planned examples.
CLAUDE.md testing section now mentions compileall and the existing unittest suite.
acceptance: Docs no longer claim functions or coverage that are absent from current code.
Agent-facing instructions match current CLI behavior.

tracks.title: Expand pure-function unit coverage
tracks.current_issue: Several high-impact helpers have little or no test coverage.
implementation_notes: Added coverage for parse_range_string(), split_subtitle_entries(), format_srt_time(), mask_punctuations(), and annotate_polyphones().
Added model-free generate_audio_clip subtitle-policy coverage with fakes.
Tests remain lightweight and do not load the real TTS model.
acceptance: uv run python -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_*.py' covers these helpers.
The suite remains fast and model-free.

tracks.title: Clarify and optionally expose text preprocessing ownership
tracks.current_issue: Project-level punctuation cleanup and CosyVoice frontend normalization both affect text, but ownership is mostly implicit.
implementation_notes: Keep novel-specific cleanup in txt2audio.
Leave text normalization and split_paragraph behavior to CosyVoice unless a tested reason exists.
Either wire model_sentence_limit into behavior or keep it documented as informational.
acceptance: No duplicate hard-to-verify normalization layer is added.
Config and docs clearly describe which layer owns each transformation.

tracks.title: Expand polyphone annotations only with sampled audio validation
tracks.current_issue: The docs have historically described broader polyphone support than the current conservative implementation.
implementation_notes: Add only high-value characters that are often misread and tokenized reliably.
Keep annotations sparse to preserve naturalness.
Pair each addition with focused text samples.
acceptance: Token legality is covered by tests.
Representative audio samples are checked before documenting broader support.

tracks.title: Add an optional run-plan JSON mode
tracks.current_issue: Agents can validate paths today, but cannot inspect planned generation and resume actions without starting media generation.
implementation_notes: Keep this separate from --validate-paths.
Report selected chapters, target files, existing/skipped outputs, output format, and subtitle/video actions.
Do not load the TTS model.
acceptance: Plan mode is deterministic and model-free.
JSON output is suitable for preflight confirmation.

tracks.title: Evaluate optional export and UX enhancements
tracks.current_issue: Useful additions exist, but they should not precede reliability fixes.
implementation_notes: Consider explicit SRT export/keep flags.
Consider M4B or chapter manifest export.
Improve cover long-title wrapping and scaling.
Include success/skipped/failed file lists in summaries.
acceptance: Selected enhancements are implemented only after P0 issues are resolved.

commands: uv run python -m compileall src tests
uv run python -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_*.py'
notes: unittest discover ran 20 tests successfully after P0 and P1 additions.
Targeted P1 utility/subtitle coverage passed without loading the TTS model.

next_step.title: Add remaining special-section fixtures before parser enhancements
next_step.why: The main P0 fixes and core helper coverage are complete; chapter parser behavior should get a few more fixtures before any recognition rules are broadened.
